status: Completed and restored; repeatable workload-dependent CPU differences, no established power saving
visual_observation: User reported completion; no new visual assessment requested. Both drivers looked smooth in the preceding monitored run

power_assessment.note: Predeclared diagnostic screens, not proof of equal output, thermal equilibrium or isolated driver power. All observations remain in the raw summary. No background watts are subtracted.

background_evidence: Cron CPU was negligible; per-sample cgroup totals retain terminal and Firefox activity. Inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed.
limitations: Observed CPU differences are from noisy samples and do not establish power/heat savings
This compares official normal copying with Vino plus EVDI batching, not GPU encoding alone
Cgroup totals retain short-lived CPU; browser/terminal activity persists and varies by condition. Correlation does not establish that this is independent noise or driver-induced work
AMD PPT is not whole-laptop/wall power; thermal/fan readings are not controlled steady-state outcomes
Matched 20 Hz synthetic input does not prove equal codec quality or physical 60 FPS output
These fixed diagnostic thresholds excluded all power pairs; that is not proof of a failed run or that raw observations contain no information
